ruleDefinitions.name: File Download via CertOC.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user downloads a file by using CertOC.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertOC\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-GetCACAPS.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")))
